description: Apply owner's preferred Dead City settings: invert lighting ON-first; flicker intensity 1.5; idle glow 0; flash chance .4; brightness 1.5; light range multiplier .25; warmth .25; rain radius 5m. Add warLampFlashDistance=8m live setting: streetlight bulbs, ground pools and actual point lights cannot flicker unless player's horizontal distance from source <= configured radius; distant explosion sprites/tracers remain visible but explosion world illumination is suppressed unless within radius. All other tuning defaults, gameplay, saves, HubSide portal and Metal FM 10% default preserved.
